node.title: Re^2: methods for dealing with zero '0' as a string or char
node.author: Eily
node.doctext:
I already /msg'd AnomalousMonk about it but maybe a post is a better idea: v5.26 had a section on [https://perldoc.perl.org/5.26.0/perlsyn.html#Truth-and-Falsehood|Truth and Falsehood] but not [https://perldoc.perl.org/5.28.0/perlsyn.html#Truth-and-Falsehood|v5.28]. I suppose this information is still supposed to be found somewhere in the documentation, but I have no idea where...

Edit: it is in [doc://perldata#Scalar-values|perldata]
